name: Bloom: Content repurposing (blog post → on-brand images for every channel)

parameters.formDescription: Paste a finished blog post and the captions you already wrote for each platform. Bloom generates the on-brand image for every channel; your copy is never rewritten.

values.placeholder: The title of the published blog post
The full blog post text (plain text)
The caption that will be published with the Instagram post
The caption that will be published with the LinkedIn post
The tweet that will be published with the image

options.formDescription: Submitting starts the generation: 4 on-brand images, one per channel. The button will keep loading while they render (about 2 minutes); the results page opens in this tab when done. Live node-by-node progress is visible in the n8n editor tab.

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const imageId = $json.data?.ids?.[0] ?? $json.data?.imageIds?.[0]; if (!imageId) { throw new Error('Bloom generate response is missing an image id.'); } return `https://www.trybloom.ai/api/v1/images/${imageId}?wait=true&timeout=295`; })() }}

={{ $json.data.status === 'completed' && $json.data.imageUrl ? $json.data.imageUrl : (() => { throw new Error('Bloom image not ready (status: ' + ($json.data.status || 'unknown') + '). Increase the wait timeout or check the generation.'); })() }}
